doc: What a dispatched run may not change: the things that decide whether its own work passes. An agent may propose a change to any of these; it may not make one in the same run as the work that change would judge. A dispatched run's diff that touches a path here is refused before it reaches a branch.

paths.why: Gates, trust, tools, models and this list itself.
The rules every prompt starts with.
The project's format, lint, build and test commands are what the gates run. Changing one changes what passing means.
A role's overlay says what that role must show before its work counts as done.
The tasks an evolution candidate is scored on.
What the definitions are checked against.
Continuous integration decides what passing means on the main line.

note: Add the paths of your own evaluators: benchmark data, golden files, CI scripts.
